capture.command: POST /api/experimental/session/import with a subagent launch and its completion wake, then curl -u "opencode:$OPENCODE_SERVER_PASSWORD" "$OPENCODE_URL/api/session/<session>/message?order=asc&limit=200"
capture.note: Hand-sanitized excerpt (3 contiguous rows) of an unfiltered read of a real opencode 2.4.2 session created through the import endpoint: one completed `subagent` tool part whose metadata still says the run is `running`, and the child's completion Wake in 2.4's unified `<background-result kind="subagent" … description="…">` text (2.3 and earlier used a `<subagent …>` tag). Message/tool/child-session ids, times, prompts and free text are anonymized fixture values; wire field names, metadata keys and statuses are verbatim. The import endpoint serializes the same shapes the projector writes.
